# WakeLeap — Mission-Based Alarm Clock App

> WakeLeap is a mission-based alarm clock app built by Dialed Labs Inc. for Android and iOS. To silence the alarm, the user must complete a pre-configured Mission such as an Object Hunt, push-ups, a photo, making the bed, or reading a Bible verse.

## App

- Marketing name: WakeLeap
- Google Play listing: Wayk - Mission Alarm Clock App
- App Store listing: Wake Up Alarm Clock Missions
- Developer (marketing site): Dialed Labs Inc.
- Category: Alarm clock / productivity / morning routine
- Core differentiator: Mission-based wake-up. The alarm does not stop until the Mission is completed. No tap-to-dismiss.

## Platforms

- Android: available now on Google Play, requires Android 8.0 (API 26) or above
- iOS: available now on the App Store, requires iOS 15 or above

## Store URLs

- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.alrighttech.wayk
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wake-up-alarm-clock-missions/id6817215800

## Pricing

- Free: all features included
- No subscription, no trial, no paid tier

## Mission types at launch

- Object Hunt (find and photograph an object)
- Physical Exercise (push-ups or reps)
- Photo Mission (photo of sky, face, made bed)
- Make Your Bed (photo or confirmation)
- Read a Bible Verse (confirm reading)

## Key facts

- Alarm triggers within plus or minus 2 seconds of configured time.
- Mission screen renders within 1 second of trigger.
- Core alarm and missions work fully offline.
- Alarm scheduler survives device restarts.
- Streak counter tracks consecutive successful mission completions.
- Supports independent alarm volume, gradual fade-in, vibration, and silent mode override.
